anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Taken on the tenth, sacrificed on the fourteenth.

pass_a_gloss: And as there not at the same time as taking on the tenth is the sheep sacrificed but on the fourteenth, five days having passed, so here too the one who has taken the true sheep, that is Christ, does not at once sacrifice and chew, but five days having passed after the taking of him.
pass_b_english: And as there the sheep is not sacrificed at the same time as it is taken on the tenth, but on the fourteenth, five days having passed, so here too [the one who has taken the true sheep, that is Christ, does not at once sacrifice and chew, but five days having passed after the taking of him.]
source_text: Καὶ ὡς ἐκεῖ οὐχ ἅμα τῷ λαβεῖν τῇ δεκάτῃ τὸ πρόβατον θύεται ἀλλὰ τῇ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῃ, πέντε ἡμερῶν διαγενομένων, καὶ ἐνθάδε|| [ὁ τὸ ἀληθινὸν πρόβατον λαβών, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν Χ(ριστό)ν, οὐκ εὐθέως θύει καὶ τρώγει, ἀλλ’ ἡμερῶν πέντε διαγενομένων μετὰ τὴν λῆψιν αὐτοῦ.
